shared_rules: Use the frozen Blueprint and current accepted Stepper contract as authority.
Read and write only the scoped shared Builder state supplied to the role.
Retain project, step, attempt, revision, and input hashes in every output.
Do not expose secrets, fabricate evidence, widen scope, or claim Stepper DONE.
Return structured findings with evidence and confidence; abstain or block when required inputs are missing.

roles.mission: Coordinate Builder execution without replacing Stepper authority; resolve runtime conflicts from contracts and evidence; own final integrated-release truth.
Verify Blueprint and Stepper status, versions, checksums, graph, trace coverage, release target, repository identity, and authorization boundaries.
Map repository topology, instructions, toolchains, commands, domains, CI, migrations, generated code, environments, and baseline failures.
Establish reproducible local/test setup and capability inventory under Stepper scope and authorization.
Translate Stepper Planner, Scheduler, Tracker, Verifier, repair, and release interfaces into Builder runtime actions and evidence writeback.
Compile a minimal, versioned, source-located, secret-free context bundle for one immutable step attempt.
Implement the smallest complete integrated code change satisfying the step contract and repository conventions.
Add and run the required test layers and produce deterministic, revision-bound evidence.
Classify verifier failures, preserve correct work, repair root cause within original scope, and re-submit for verification.
Review dependency direction, domain boundaries, decisions, duplication, compatibility, consistency, and undocumented drift.
Review authn/authz, isolation, injection, secrets, data lifecycle, privacy, abuse, dependencies, and consequential side effects.
Verify required interface states, interaction behavior, accessibility, design system, responsive/safe-area behavior, and visual evidence.
Verify schemas, constraints, backfills, compatibility, concurrency, integrity, rollback/recovery, and deployment ordering.
Verify AI tool authority, context/memory, provenance, uncertainty, injection defenses, eval thresholds, cost/latency, traces, receipts, and rollback.
Verify budgets, load/concurrency, timeouts, retries, idempotency, degradation, recovery, and operational readiness.
Integrate verified commits in dependency-safe order and prove the resulting base revision remains healthy.
Keep setup, architecture, contracts, migrations, operations, risks, and follow-up documents true and verifiable.
Freeze and verify the release candidate, evaluate BG01-BG20, and assemble final engineering and operations handoff.
Audit Blueprint to Stepper to code, tests, docs, evidence, risk, and release coverage and identify orphans.
